## Introduction

In this post, we will explore the foundational concepts of Multilevel Modeling (MLM). When dealing with nested data, standard OLS regression assumptions are often violated due to grouped errors.

## Mathematical Formulation

The random intercept model can be expressed as follows:

$$y_{ij} = \beta_{0j} + \beta_{1} x_{ij} + e_{ij}$$

## Data Visualization with Code

We can simulate and plot this relationship directly within our post.

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Sample plot generation
x = np.linspace(0, 10, 100)
y = 2 + 1.5 * x + np.random.normal(0, 1, 100)

plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
plt.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.6, color='blue')
plt.title("Simulated Nested Data")
plt.show()
